correctness.rationale: The exact binomial two-survivor tail has strictly positive marginal \(j p^2(1-p)^{j-1}\). For any two groups, the threshold Q_s(t) is strictly increasing by monotonicity of artanh(z)/z, so the two-group expected-site count has its maxima only at merged or balanced endpoints. This rules out every unbalanced optimal partition and proves the exact candidate formula for all integers N>=2 and all 0<p<1. Exact polynomial differences prove the N=6 thresholds. Executable standalone checker passed 7049 exact-rational finite assertions.

originality.rationale: The earliest directly motivated source, Shea and Possingham, optimizes a distinct multi-year fixed-strategy biological-control release model. Primary full-text checks of four sources, one abstract-level source, four targeted mathematical-database searches and mathematical/general-resource search uncovered no equivalent unrestricted integer-allocation theorem. This is best-knowledge originality only, with residual possibility of broad sigmoidal-allocation theory covering it.
residual_risks: An unlocated general theorem for separable S-shaped integer resource allocation may imply the balanced-size rule without this formulation.
The Fernandez et al. 2012 article was accessible at abstract level only; its uninspected body could contain a related condition.
This discrete Bernoulli survival model is deliberately simpler than realistic stochastic metapopulation dynamics; no empirical claim is made.

value.rationale: The exact number-and-size decision for a fixed stock of potential biological-control or restoration founders is an identified ecology management gap. The global optimizer for arbitrary N collapses to floor(N/2) balanced candidates despite a nonconcave establishment curve; the six-founder case exhibits two exact switching probabilities and rules out unequal mixed release strategies. This supplies a structurally motivated result rather than a mere isolated probability calculation.
